statement: Generic affine hyperplane sections of St(2,2)=O(2,C) have monodromy C_2×C_2 on four solutions, with the two determinant components giving two invariant orbits of size two.

group.description: C2×C2, nontransitive action with two orbits of size two

source.location: Elementary decomposition of O(2) into its determinant components; direct proof in notes

scope: Unrestricted generic affine hyperplanes in the four matrix entries of St(2,2).
notes: The components are matrices [[a,b],[-b,a]] and [[a,b],[b,-a]], each with a²+b²=1. A general affine hyperplane restricts to A_+a+B_+b=c and A_-a+B_-b=c. The four coefficients A_+,B_+,A_-,B_- vary independently. Each conic section is a quadratic cover branched at A_±²+B_±²=c². At c=1, a small loop around a smooth point of either branch hypersurface, avoiding the other, swaps just that pair. The group is therefore the full product C2×C2. Its permutation action is nontransitive and must not be linked to the transitive LMFDB action 4T2. The LMFDB URL identifies the abstract group; the stated nontransitive permutation action and its orbit sizes are retained.
